title: Story
body: Before the camera comes out we find the one thing people say about your place when you're not in the room. The film is built around that.

title: Colour
body: Graded in Resolve, never a preset. Warm where the food is, honest where the people are, and it will look the same on a phone in daylight as it does on your screen.

title: Sound
body: The room, the pour, the kitchen at seven. We record it and mix it. Music is chosen last, so it serves the picture instead of hiding it.
